name: muster-mfa-report-only
description: Edge case for MFA state detection: a CA policy with the mfa grant in report-only mode ('enabledForReportingButNotEnforced') — Graph's third policy state. Report-only does NOT enforce, so a correct detector reports 'no'.

steps.note: MFA grant in report-only mode -> iam-001/iam-004 must stay 'no'
